# doodlecricket.github.io

**Generated — do not edit here.** This repo is the GitHub Pages output for
<https://doodlecricket.github.io>. The source lives in
[doodlecricket/doodlecricket-web](https://github.com/doodlecricket/doodlecricket-web);
every commit here is a deploy of it (`Deploy doodlecricket-web@<sha> ...`).

To change the site, edit `doodlecricket-web` and deploy from there
(`npm run deploy`, or push to `main` and let its GitHub Action deploy).
A deploy deletes anything here that the build does not produce, apart from
this README, `LICENSE`, `.gitignore`, `project.json` and the legacy files
listed in `doodlecricket-web/scripts/deploy-filter.txt`.

(Google LLC, STUDIO4°C).
